fields.name: OrleansDbPersistenceOptions
fields.description: Public data used by OrleansDbPersistenceOptions to select its database/provider and hold its grain-type-indexed query contracts.

members.name: DatabaseKey
members.description: The database configuration key and Orleans provider key; defaults to "Common".

members.name: Queries
members.description: Maps each grain type to its available CRUD query definitions; defaults to an empty dictionary.

members.name: InitStage
members.description: The silo lifecycle stage at which storage must be initialized before use; defaults to ApplicationServices.
